status_filter: outgoing types and NOT in {DRAFT CANCELLED VOID CREDITED}
notes: Finalized outgoing invoice is the revenue authority; not bookings/payments/deposits

status_filter: payment on outgoing invoice; settled (row exists)
notes: Cash inflow authority; authorizations/pending intents are not rows here

status_filter: incoming types and NOT in {DRAFT CANCELLED VOID REJECTED}
notes: Only existing incoming invoices; no estimated/E4 cost model

status_filter: outgoing open (not paid/void/cancelled/credited/draft) and outstanding>0 and NOT overdue
notes: Partial payments reduce outstanding; never negative

status_filter: open receivable and (status OVERDUE or dueDate<reference)
notes: dueDate is the authority; createdAt never used as due date

notes: Refund affects cashflow in its own settlement period; revenue correction only via credit note/void
Kept distinct from customer revenue; not netted into revenue
